owner_ruling.supersedes: D-17 TA cohort-target wording and generic acting_officer grantability only
owner_ruling.capacity_rule: Chairperson or Vice-Chairperson for the target cooperative may grant or revoke internal_verifier, field_agent, and sourced delegate capacities; a valid persisted acting_officer appointment/delegation for either office may exercise that office but generic capacity commands cannot create or revoke acting_officer.
owner_ruling.assisted_enrolment_exception: A platform_enroller may grant only internal_verifier when an open persisted session for the authenticated enroller and target cooperative identifies the representative and records the enroller's typed attestations of representative presence, NRC sighting and consent to act; the strict grant command records that representative's explicit grant decision against that session.
owner_ruling.ta_scope_rule: A programme_manager may grant or revoke TA scope for one eligible persisted cooperative per command only when that cooperative is in the manager's persisted ta_delegation scope; the delegatee must have an active union_ta assignment through the recorded union/federation. Agreement references are documentary only.

conditional_actor_classes.acting_officer: Active delegation names chairperson or vice_chairperson and matches target organization.
conditional_actor_classes.platform_enroller: capacityType is internal_verifier and an active assisted-enrolment session records representative presence and grant decision for the target organization.

conditional_actor_classes.acting_officer: Active delegation names chairperson or vice_chairperson and matches target organization.

precedence: Malformed action, target, actor, timestamp, or authority evidence denies.
Unknown action or parameter values deny.
Institutional read-only role denies before action-specific authority is considered.
Tenant and resource scope must match before appointment, capacity, delegation, or role rules can allow.
Only then apply the action's explicit authority rule; governance advisory/warning modes cannot override an authorization denial.

temporal_semantics.revocation: A revoked authority is represented by its effective end time; at the end-time equality the authority is inactive.

phase2_exclusions.reason: IFV finding workflow and person-based conflicts remain original Phase 2 Feature 05.
Person/account linkage is not a Phase 1 authority dependency.
Revocation preserves historical findings; no Phase 2 annotation workflow is added.
